Subject: Invoice INV-3321 — bank verification and expected settle window

Hi Mina,

We're preparing payment for Invoice INV-3321 but our bank reported the ACH entry as 'unmatched' on first pass. Can you confirm the micro-deposit amounts you expect for verification and whether Redwood will accept a staggered settlement (50% today, 50% on 12/29) if our treasury approves?

We can also push a one-time virtual card if ACH doesn't clear; need to know if there's a card-fee pass-through or if Redwood prefers a full-wire fallback.

Attached is our payrun clearing statement showing the failed trace (payrun-1123-clearing-statement.pdf).

Thanks,
Terry
Terry Cho
AP Manager — PhotonAI
[Attachment: payrun-1123-clearing-statement.pdf]

Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-3321 — bank verification and expected settle window

Hi Terry — thanks for the note and the attachment.

Short answers up front:
- Micro-deposits we send are $0.12 and $0.37 (standard verification).
- We can accept a phased settlement: 50% today (as soon as funds clear) and remainder no later than 2026-12-29, provided we receive proof of funds for the first tranche.
- If you need to push a virtual card, Redwood will invoice the card surcharge (2.5%) unless you accept our net-of-fees option and we absorb up to $150 for one-time exceptions — please confirm.

Action items for your AP team: please reply with the bank account last4, routing number (masked is fine) and attach the micro-deposit trace when available. If ACH still fails, we'll coordinate a wire; Jonas will generate a remittance stub and Marissa will confirm the final remit date.

Cc'ing Jonas and Marissa to coordinate internal steps.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0124

Plan confirmed:

- Card surcharge: Redwood will absorb up to $150 for this one-time exception; any excess will be passed through — please confirm acceptance in reply.

Jonas / Marissa — please attach the remittance stub to the HubSpot record and flag the invoice for phased settlement. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/PHOTONAI

Thanks all — Merry (early) holidays.
